name: comp-374
blurb: Full-featured dropdown with icons, submenus, and controls.
description: A comprehensive dropdown combining icons, keyboard shortcuts, nested submenus with radio buttons and checkboxes for controlling settings.
use_when: App menus with settings, options, and complex user control in one place.
avoid_when: Simple menus or mobile-first interfaces where this complexity is unwieldy.
a11y: Full keyboard navigation; icons aria-hidden; nested controls have proper roles.
